# t32.3 — ADR-0007 D4 exact summary cardinality

## Summary

Closed the remaining t32.1 HIGH finding. `AgentLoadRejectionReportingTest` now collects every
`Agent load summary:` event and asserts an exact size of one on both the rejection and
zero-rejection paths before checking message content and WARN/INFO level. The production loader
already emitted one summary per load, so no production change was required.

Also corrected the stale `AgentSchemaCoverageTest` Javadoc: ADR-0007 records the current
14-element schema, while the executable guard continues deriving the component set reflectively.

## Duplicate-Emission Negative Control

An isolated `/tmp/t32_3_mutant` copy added a second `reportOutcome(...)` invocation after the
production invocation. With the final test source:

- `summaryEmittedOnRejection`: RED — expected size 1, observed 2.
- `summaryEmittedWithNoRejections`: RED — expected size 1, observed 2.
- Mutant result: 5 run, 2 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped; Maven exit 1 as required.

The default-level visibility test remained focused on observability rather than duplicating the
cardinality contract.
